messages.content: The first man on the glass rooftop had clothes in what color?
Green.
How did the stranger carry on after reaching the edge of the glass roof?
He walked on the air.
Why did nobody pay special attention to Dorothy and Zeb as the balloon fell?
Same size as the Mangaboos.
What was Eureka's sleeping spot as the balloon came down?
On the buggy seat.
When a Mangaboo grows shoots, what do they do to it?
They must be planted at once.
What was the plant that produced the Mangaboo royal line?
The Royal Bush.
Why is a Mangaboo clothed even while still on its plant?
It grew on their bodies.
What did the group say the moving vines looked like from above?
A nest of snakes.
What did the group hear in Voe without finding the creature making it?
A bird twittering.
What did the Wizard imagine the Gargoyles would use their prisoners for?
For a ceremony.
How did Eureka describe the shape of the dragonettes' mouths?
Coal-scuttles.
How many years back did the young dragon trace its ancestors?
About twenty thousand years.
What did Ozma say the Wizard would be if he made his home in Oz?
Official Wizard.
What did Jim graze on when he stopped for breakfast with the beasts?
Clover.
How many lawyers were available for the kitten's case?
None.
After getting the blue ribbon, what did the Braided Man offer the little girl?
A box of rustles.
